description.zh:
交換兩個單字：請依照下方英文原題的輸入、輸出規格完成程式。

C++ 沒有 Python 切片語法；請使用索引、迴圈、substr()、find()、rfind()、erase() 或 replace()。
description.en:
Given a string consisting of exactly two words separated by a space. Print a new string with the first and second word positions swapped (the second word is printed first).

This task should not use loops and if.

C++ note: C++ has no Python slice syntax. Use indexes, loops, substr(), find(), rfind(), erase(), or replace().

hint.zh: C++ 沒有 Python 切片語法；請使用索引、迴圈、substr()、find()、rfind()、erase() 或 replace()。
